annotations.title: Get the relationships of an entity

description: The relationships of an entity of the map (a covered company, a bank, an owner, a subsidiary): its lenders and borrowers with the commitments that the schedules of the credit agreements prove, its major customers and suppliers with the share of revenue, its owners and holdings, partners and related parties, each link with its evidence and documents, and for a covered company the measures of its relationships and the links of its group. With to, the chain of links between 2 entities and the counterparties that both name, in the sentences of the Connections view of the site. Every list states count, whether it is complete and next, the cursor for the rest.

cursor.description: the next of an earlier answer, for the next page of the same call

direction.description: from: where the entity lends, sells or owns; to: where it borrows, buys or is owned (default both)

entity.description: the entity of a search result, for example general-motors, bank-of-montreal or dbs-bank-ltd

group.description: include the entities of the group of a covered company (default true)

max_links.description: with to: the longest chain looked for (default 4)

to.description: a second entity: the chain of links between the 2 and their shared counterparties

name: get_relationships
title: Get the relationships of an entity
